Office Notes, reports,
 orders or proceedings SL.
 Date or directions and COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS No  Registrar's order with  Signatures  WPCRL No.04 of 2026  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Ms. Prabha Naithani, learned counsel for the Petitioners.
2.
Mr. S. S. Chauhan, learned D.A.G. assisted by Mr. Vikash Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is filed by the Petitioners to quash the impugned FIR dated 18.04.2025 registered as Case Crime No.98 of 2025, under Section 420 of IPC, at Police Station Kankhal, District Haridwar and further to direct the Respondents not to arrest the Petitioners in connection with the abovementioned F.I.R..
4.
Issue notice to the Respondent no.3, returnable within two weeks.

Steps to be taken within one week.
7. Objections, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.
8.

9. In the interregnum, it is directed that the investigation shall proceed but the Petitioners shall not be arrested by the police in connection with the impugned FIR dated 18.04.2025 registered as Case Crime No.98 of 2025, under Section 420 of IPC, at Police Station Kankhal, District Haridwar.

However, they will continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of their statements.
10.
Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2026) stands disposed of.

(Ashish Naithani, J.) 05.01.2026 Akash WPCRL/4/2026 on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79725357/
